text:
You need a 1–3 page WordPress site for a personal trainer, with a member login area where videos can be organized into fitness-related sections and updated later with new testimonials, services, and education content.

I’m Tobias Reyne, a full-stack developer with 7 years of experience building web apps and client-facing platforms. While your site is WordPress-based, I’ve built similar user experiences around structured content, gated access, and clean editing workflows, so the membership side can stay simple for you to manage after launch.

One relevant project was a booking platform for fitness studios for Pulsebox Studios. I built a white-label class booking app where each studio had its own subdomain, timetable, and memberships. That platform onboarded 64 studios in 6 months and achieved 71% checkout conversion. The experience was valuable because it involved fitness businesses, subscription-style access, and making the user journey straightforward for both admins and members.

For your site, I’d approach it as a polished marketing website with a secure member portal, clear sectioning for video content, and an easy way for you to edit testimonials, services, and educational content later. Since your videos are already on Loom, embedding them into organized folders/headings is a practical setup. I’d also make sure the layout is mobile-friendly and simple for visitors to understand.

Given the scope, I’d estimate this as a relatively focused build. If the content is ready and the structure is clear, I’d expect it to take about 1–2 weeks to complete. Budget-wise, I’d suggest discussing it based on the final scope of the login system, content organization, and any design revisions you want, since those details will determine the total effort.

I’d be happy to help you shape this into a clean, easy-to-update membership site. One question I have is: do you want the member portal to be password-only access, or should users be able to create their own accounts and log in individually?
